notes: Jilan Police Services v1.0: Punjab Police official services helper — big tap-to-dial emergency 15 card, Punjab Police official website (punjabpolice.gov.pk) inside the app for Khidmat Markaz services (character certificate, learner licence, vehicle verification, tenant registration, FIR copy requests), service guides and a stay-safe fraud warning (FIA 1991). The app collects and saves nothing.
